title: Rule 30 ASIC-Saturated State Machine via Binary-Tower SNARK
content: Approved next step. Shipped machine remains Winterfell F_p. Native char-2 step is s'_i = s_{i-1} + s_i + s_{i+1} + s_i*s_{i+1}. Binary-tower AIR is one degree-2 constraint per cell. Sequentiality and ASIC saturation are not measured in this repo.
